territories.name: Quicksand
territories.text: If a player begins their Movement on Quicksand, they cannot voluntarily Fall Back or move more than one Position that turn. Forced displacement is unaffected.

effects.label: Text

territories.name: Poisonous Gas
territories.text:
During a battle on Poisonous Gas, each player may set a Gambit or choose a Tactic, but not both. A player cannot have more than one Gambit or Tactic in that battle.
A Tactic chosen during that battle goes to its owner's Graveyard during the Aftermath of the battle instead of their Discard Pile. If a player chooses no Tactic, they put one unchosen card from their initial Reserve in their Graveyard during the Aftermath, if able.

territories.name: Difficult Terrain
territories.text: When a player enters Difficult Terrain, their movement ends. A player who begins their turn there or enters it during their turn cannot play a card for its Action effect during Denouement that turn.

territories.name: Disrupted Supply Lines
territories.text: While a player occupies Disrupted Supply Lines, only 1 of their Assets can be active. They choose which one remains active; their other Assets are inactive until they leave.

territories.name: Ruined Storehouse
territories.text: Once during their Draw step, a player occupying Ruined Storehouse may draw the top card of their Discard Pile instead of drawing from their Draw Pile.

territories.name: Field Hospital
territories.text: During the Aftermath of a battle on Field Hospital, when the battle cards are cleared, its controller may put one card they controlled in that battle that would enter their Graveyard in their Discard Pile instead.

territories.name: Command Tent
territories.text: If a player begins their turn occupying and controlling Command Tent, they may take one Action during both Opening and Denouement that turn. If they do, both Actions may be used only to play cards for their Action effects.

territories.name: Training Grounds
territories.text: When Training Grounds's controller defends it, after forming their initial Reserve but before choosing Tactics, they may discard that entire Reserve and draw the same number of replacement cards. Those cards become their Reserve.

territories.name: Toll Bridge
territories.text: To voluntarily advance from Toll Bridge, a player must discard one card from their Hand. If they cannot, they cannot advance from it.

territories.name: Smuggler's Run
territories.text:
During Opening or Denouement, as an Action, while occupying and controlling Smuggler's Run, a player may stash one card from their Hand face down beneath it. The stashed card does not count toward the Hand limit.
While that player occupies and controls Smuggler's Run, they may play the stashed card for its Action effect or set it as a Gambit as though it were in their Hand, if eligible. It counts as a card played or set from Hand.
At the start of the stashing player's turn, if they control Smuggler's Run, they may return the stashed card to their Hand. If they lose control of Smuggler's Run, put the stashed card in its owner's Discard Pile. Only one card may be stashed here.

rules_notes: Arenas are Territories. A Deck may include no more than one Arena among its three selected Territories.

territories.name: Arena: Spoils of War
territories.text:
During battles on Spoils of War, Defensive Edge does not apply. If battle totals remain tied, make a Tiebreak Roll.
During the Aftermath of the battle, when cards remaining in Reserve move to the Discard Pile, the winner may put one unchosen card from their Reserve in their Hand instead.
